character_profiles.reference_prompt: Full body shot of Dr. Anya Sharma, an AI Futurist and Host. She is a woman in her late 30s to early 40s, with an average, athletic, and professional build. Her face is intelligent, friendly, approachable, and expressive, featuring a warm smile and sharp, engaging eyes. She has dark, sleek, medium-length hair styled in a modern, professional way. She wears sleek, professional tech-wear: a tailored deep navy blazer made of a futuristic fabric over a clean, white minimalist top, paired with charcoal grey smart trousers. Subtle electric blue accents are incorporated into her outfit, and she wears a futuristic smart watch. Her posture is confident and engaging. The overall art style is sleek digital art, futuristic, clean lines, professional, high-tech, vibrant, and concept art.
